# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published version of `ThorstenSauter.AspNetCore.Authentication.DeviceBoundSessions` receives fixes.
There are no maintained release branches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ThorstenSauter/AspNetCore.DeviceBoundSessions/security/advisories/new).
Do **not** open a public issue for anything security-sensitive.

When reporting, please include:

- a description of the vulnerability and its impact,
- the steps or a proof of concept needed to reproduce it,
- the package version and the configuration of `AddDeviceBoundSession` involved.

If the issue also affects the original implementation in
[dotnet/aspnetcore](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore), please report it to Microsoft as well, following
[their security policy](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/policy).

## What to expect

This is a small, single-maintainer project. Reports are acknowledged within a few days, and you will be kept
updated on the assessment and the fix. You will be credited in the release notes unless you prefer to stay
anonymous. There is no bug bounty.
